name: Fantasy Football Coach (High)
tagline: Reads a roster screenshot and returns start-bench, waiver and trade calls for the week
description: Send one screenshot of your fantasy roster and the advice comes back concrete: who belongs in the lineup, which free agents justify a waiver claim, who is safe to release, and whether a proposed trade helps you. Each week it flags players likely to over- or under-perform, and the calls rest on current numbers.
author: Hightv
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
